This editorial illustration depicts a large-scale caricature of a man in a blue suit and yellow tie, appearing to float or sink underwater. He has short greyish hair, wears black glasses, and has an alarmed facial expression with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. His body is small relative to his head. His right arm is bent upward, palm facing out, while his left arm reaches down toward the lower-right corner.

The background is a light-blue gradient with various-sized translucent white bubbles rising around the figure. Several small, dark, horizontal fish silhouettes swim in the distance. In the lower right, a 100,000 Indonesian Rupiah banknote floats diagonally, showing the faces of two men.

Large red text reads "TEMPO" across the top, with a red "50" overlapping the letter "O." Smaller text includes "Silang-Sengkarut Revisi UU Pemilu H.26," "Dagang Pemeriksaan Komisioner Ombudsman H.58," and "BESAR UTANG DARIPADA TIANG" in bold black. A bar code, a QR code, and publication details like "27 APRIL-3 MEI 2026" and "RP 60.000" are at the bottom.
